name: Noise band backdrop
description: A tinted fbm noise band that rises up the backdrop, leans toward the pointer, swells while you type and surges while a prompt runs.

propDocs.tint: Colour of the band edge and its wash. The default follows the section tint.
propDocs.ground: Colour the band is mixed from. The default follows the page ground.
propDocs.stateVariable: Name of a text variable. The value searching raises the band by Surge while busy, answer by Surge when done, anything else lowers it. A number variable is used as the surge directly.
propDocs.activityVariable: Name of a variable whose changes make the band swell for a moment, for example the text typed into a prompt.
propDocs.surgeBusy: How far the band rises while the state variable reads searching, as a fraction of the height.
propDocs.surgeDone: How far the band stays risen when the state variable reads answer.
propDocs.pointer: The band leans toward the pointer when on.
propDocs.speed: Multiplier for the slow drift of the noise. 1 is the original pace.

fallback: Without WebGL the same field is painted on a small 2D canvas on the CPU; if that fails too, a plain ground gradient shows. With reduced motion one still frame is drawn and it only repaints when the state variable, the theme or the size changes.
